title: Ask the Expert: Yahoo DSP and audience targeting | Experian

facts.fact: Yahoo ConnectID reaches 213 million logged-in users in the U.S., according to Yahoo data for Q1 2026.
facts.quote: today reaches 213 million logged-in users in the U.S. and 345 million globally (_Yahoo data Q1 2026_).

facts.fact: Yahoo ConnectID works with 40+ leading Customer Data Platforms and Data Management Platforms, according to Yahoo's own description.
facts.quote: Yahoo ConnectID works with 40+ leading Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and Data Management Platforms (DMPs)

facts.fact: Yahoo DSP reports that 90% of its spend runs on Yahoo ConnectID-enabled supply.
facts.quote: 90% of Yahoo DSP spend runs on Yahoo ConnectID-enabled supply

facts.fact: Yahoo Blueprint Performance has 10x faster response times than prior bidding, according to Yahoo's internal Yahoo DSP data for Q4 2025.
facts.quote: with 10x faster response times that consider the size of the spike and the advertiser's remaining budget and flight (_Internal Yahoo DSP data, Q4 2025_)

facts.fact: Yahoo DSP provides access to 100% non-walled garden CTV inventory, according to Yahoo's description.
facts.quote: we provide access to 100% non-walled garden CTV inventory

facts.fact: According to Yahoo DSP, a leading retail network saw a 22% lift in ROAS when activating Yahoo In-Flight Outcomes (IFO), per Yahoo DSP Q1-Q2 2025 data.
facts.quote: For example, a leading retail network saw a 22% lift in ROAS when activating Yahoo IFO (_Yahoo DSP Q1-Q2 2025_).

facts.fact: Yahoo states its ConnectID identity solution is built on hundreds of millions of authenticated users.
facts.quote: Yahoo ConnectID provides that through the scale and quality of Yahoo data, built on hundreds of millions of authenticated users

facts.fact: Yahoo DSP's business development senior director Jessica Rocco has over 15 years of experience in programmatic advertising.
facts.quote: Jessica Rocco is a Senior Director of Business Development for Yahoo Demand-Side Platform (DSP), with over 15 years of experience

facts.fact: Advertisers can use Experian's demographic, lifestyle, household and credit propensity segments in Yahoo DSP to find high-value prospects while suppressing their own first-party audiences such as CRM lists, site visitors, or recent purchasers.
facts.quote: Yahoo DSP advertisers can activate Experian’s demographic, lifestyle, household and credit propensity segments to identify high-value prospects, while suppressing their own first-party audiences
